//: THE SAME SCREEN, SAID IN ENGLISH, key for key. A key that is in one catalogue and not in the other reaches the screen as a raw {key} and nothing goes red, so the parity is asserted by a test rather than by care. The model name, the VIN, the plate, the covered systems and the exclusions come from the dealership's record and are NOT translated. {key} is a hole the code fills.

route.notFoundBody: There is nothing at this address.

page.errorWhileClosed: The app could not be opened.
page.errorBody: This is a fault in the app, not something you did. The detail names the step that failed.

step.tryingPermission: get write permission on that folder
step.denied: The browser refused to {what}, without asking you. Two things cause that, and they are fixed in different places. Either this site's file editing permission is blocked — open the padlock beside the address, reset this site's permissions, reload and choose the folder again — or this browser does not offer file editing at all, which is normal in an embedded browser or inside another app. If there is no padlock to open, it is the second one: open this app in Chrome or Edge directly and the folder will work there.

start.regrantSub: Your folder is «{folder}». The browser asks you to confirm write permission every time you reopen the app.
start.chooseSub: This app keeps your maintenance record. Choose where.
start.insecureTitle: This page is not on a secure connection
start.insecureBody: The browser will not let it save anything — any browser would do the same. Open it over https, or over localhost.
start.noBrowserStorageTitle: This browser cannot save anything for this app.
start.noBrowserStorageBody: It has neither a folder picker nor storage of its own. The way out is to open the app in another browser.
start.chooseFolderNote: The record lives in a folder of yours, and your assistant can read it — that is what the MCP server reads. This is the option that makes the app worth having.
start.browserStorageNote: It survives closing, but it is not a folder of yours and your assistant cannot read it. The folder picker exists only in desktop Chromium, so this is the fallback and not an equivalent option.

state.alreadyEvaluated: This record has already been evaluated up to {when}, which is later than now ({now}). The plan below is at that later instant, not at today's, and it cannot be evaluated backwards.

notice.unreachableTitle: This is your record, not today's news.
notice.unreachableBody: The app could not reach the dealership when it opened, so whatever they have sent since last time is not here yet. Everything above is what your record already held.
notice.savingFailingBody: What you see was not saved in «{folder}». It is usually the permission, which expires every time you reopen the app.
notice.migratedTitle: Your new services now arrive through {where}, on this same phone.
notice.migratedBody: What you see here stays and is still yours; what this copy stops doing is looking for news.
notice.hostedTitle: It is being saved on this phone.
notice.hostedBody: Your record is yours and it is here: Gnothi gave this dealership a folder on your phone, and your assistant can read it from there.

home.sub: Your dealership keeps this record and is the only one that changes it. Here you read it.
home.healthWhat: operations up to date, of those your dealership scheduled
home.allGood: Your car is up to date
home.nothingDue: None of the {count} operations your dealership scheduled is overdue or due now.
home.contactTitle: Need to talk to the workshop?
home.source: This app asks nobody anything: it reads the record your dealership already sent you, which lives in {where}. {evaluated}
home.whatsappText: Hello, I would like to book {operation} for my {car} (odometer {odometer} {unit}).

services.measuredAt: What is left is measured at {instant}
services.order: Urgency sets the order, not the calendar: what is overdue first, then what is due, and what is up to date last. The dates of what has already been done do not come in the record yet.
services.summaryOverdue: It went past the interval the manufacturer published.
services.summaryDue: It reached the interval the manufacturer published.
services.summaryDueSoon: It is close to the interval the manufacturer published.
services.summaryDeferred: You asked to put it off.
services.summaryMissed: Its moment passed without being recorded.
services.summaryNotDue: Inside the interval, or with no interval scheduled for this car.
services.summaryUnknown: Your record gave this operation no state.

vehicle.note: These are the facts your dealership sent about this car. What does not appear was not ruled out: it was never mentioned, and that is a different thing.
vehicle.warrantyNotPublished: Your dealership has not published the warranty
vehicle.notReadYet: This record has not been read yet.
vehicle.manualNoneBody: Your dealership sends the manufacturer's sheet down the same path that brings everything else. Until it arrives there is nothing here to quote — and that is not a screen waiting for you to fill it in.
vehicle.manualEmptyTitle: The sheet arrived empty for this model
vehicle.manualEmptyBody: There is a sealed revision ({revision}), but it publishes neither fluids, nor tyres, nor fuel.
vehicle.pricesNoneTitle: There is no published price yet
vehicle.pricesNoneBody: Your dealership sends the manufacturer's prices down the same path that brings the sheet. Until they arrive there is nothing here to quote.

coverage.notReadYet: This record has not been read yet.
coverage.noneTitle: The manufacturer did not publish the scope
coverage.noneBody: There is nothing to quote for this model, and that does not mean there is no coverage: it means your dealership has not sent it yet.
coverage.elsewhereNone: The manufacturer did not publish a servicing-elsewhere rule for this model.

history.notReadYet: This record has not been read yet.

history.readingsNoneTitle: No odometer reading in this period

sheet.title: The manufacturer's sheet
sheet.scope: What the manufacturer published for the model {model}.
sheet.scopeRevision: The sheet in force is revision {revision}, published on {day}. Every line below names the revision it came from, which is not always this one.
sheet.absentFluids: {absent} of {total} fluids — not published for this model
sheet.absentTyres: {absent} of {total} tyre positions — not published for this model
sheet.fuelNoPermitted: no other was published as permitted

warranty.title: Where your car stands
warranty.scopeNote: Below is the scope the manufacturer published for the model {model}. It says something is inside the scope; it never says a repair will be paid for.
warranty.declaredInsideNone: no system was published as inside the scope
warranty.standingsTitle: Where your car stands in each one
warranty.exclusionsNone: No exclusion was published with this scope.

ownerIsTold.nothingHasBeenPublishedYet: Nothing has been published about this model yet. That is neither a fault nor a screen waiting for you to fill it in: your dealership sends the manufacturer's sheet, and until it arrives here there is nothing to quote.
ownerIsTold.theDealershipHasNotSentTheseFactsYet: Part of what decides this has not reached your record yet: the warranty envelope itself, the day the car was delivered, or an odometer reading taken today or earlier. The sentence above names which one, in the words of your own record. Your dealership sends all three, down the same feed that brings everything else here, so there is nothing for you to fill in and nothing worth guessing. An envelope that is not recorded here is not the same as a car with no warranty -- ask your dealership to record it.
ownerIsTold.theRecordSaysTwoThingsThatCannotBothBeTr: Two facts your dealership recorded about this car contradict each other, so where your car stands could not be fully measured and nothing above is an estimate of that. Neither fact came from you. Only your dealership can correct them: ask them to check the day they delivered the car and the odometer reading they took that day against the last reading they have sent. What the manufacturer published is below and this does not affect it.
ownerIsTold.aSystemThatIsNotListedWasNotRuledOut: These are the systems the manufacturer published, and nothing else. A system that is not on this list was not ruled out here -- it was never mentioned, which is a different thing and is worth asking your dealership about rather than assuming.
ownerIsTold.theServicingRuleStandingIsNotInThisRecor: That is the rule as it was published, not where your car stands against it. Saying that needs how many services this car has had elsewhere, how many of those have a receipt, and how much scheduled maintenance went undone. Your dealership is who puts those here.
ownerIsTold.theDaysOfAStayArriveWhenTheCarIsCollecte: The days of this stay are not counted above yet, and that is not an error in the count: the days of a stay are sent by the workshop when it hands the car back, so until then it is known that the car is in and since when, but not how many days it will have been.
ownerIsTold.theStaysAreRecordedByTheWorkshopThatRece: That there is none here does not mean your car has not been into a workshop: it means none was recorded in this period. Stays are recorded by the workshop that receives the car, down the same feed that brings everything else here, and there is nothing for you to fill in.
ownerIsTold.theDealershipSetTheDateThisOperationCoun: Your record could not answer this operation's countdown. None of the data that decides it came from you: the operation's plan and the date it counts from are set by your dealership, so there is nothing for you to fill in and nothing worth guessing. If this does not clear itself up, ask them to check that date -- it does not affect the rest of this screen.
ownerIsTold.theCompletionsAreRecordedByTheWorkshopTh: That an operation does not appear here does not mean it was never done to the car: it means it was not recorded. What is done to the car is recorded by the workshop that attends it, down the same feed that brings everything else here, and there is nothing for you to fill in.
ownerIsTold.theOdometerReadingsAreSentByTheDealershi: That there is no reading here does not mean the car has not moved in this period: it means nobody sent an odometer reading. Readings are sent by your dealership, or by the car itself when it reports, down the same feed that brings everything else here, and there is nothing for you to fill in.
ownerIsTold.theCostsAreRecordedByTheBranchThatDoesTh: That there is no cost here does not mean this car has cost you nothing in this period: it means none was recorded. Costs are recorded by the workshop or the branch that does the work, down the same feed that brings everything else here, and there is nothing for you to fill in.
